title: Browser Sub-Service Service State
description: Runs a nested pipeline inside a browser runtime, passing incoming data through it and emitting the final result. (Runtimes: browser, node, python, cpp; IDs: sub-service)

bypass.description: Skip the pipeline; the input passes through

stopPropagation.description: Whether what the pipeline produced leaves this service — see [SubService](./sub-service.md)

pipeline.description: Ordered list of services in the inner pipeline

boardName.description: Display name for the nested board

runtimeName.description: Display name of the inner runtime
